evidence_description: Comprehensive prior authorization checklist capturing Epworth score, witnessed apneas, comorbidities, and HSAT vs attended lab PSG indications.
Checklist capturing pediatric tonsillar hypertrophy, failure to thrive, and parasomnias requiring attended in-laboratory polysomnography.
Captures diagnostic AHI >= 15 or AHI 5-14 with symptoms justifying full-night or split-night CPAP/BiPAP titration study.
Specialized intake checklist for health plans lacking home sleep test coverage, collecting adult clinical suspicion of OSA for direct attended lab PSG.
